glasses_dana: Previous notes suggested bed_b1 for mid-day, but today at 14:49 it was at desk_o1. The "bed_b1 12:00-15:00" heuristic is unreliable; glasses frequently return to desk_o1 during work hours. Check desk_o1 for glasses between 09:00 and 17:00.

water_bottle_dana: Previous notes suggested dish_rack_k1 for mid-day, but today at 14:22 it was at desk_o1. The "dish_rack_k1 12:00-15:00" heuristic is inconsistent; bottles are often at desk_o1 during work. Check desk_o1 for water bottles between 09:00 and 17:00.

water_bottle_dana (evening): Previous notes suggested counter_k1 for evening, but today at 18:58 it was at kitchen_table_k1. The "counter_k1 post-18:00" heuristic is unreliable; bottles move to kitchen_table_k1 in the evening. Check kitchen_table_k1 for water bottles after 18:00.

glasses_dana (early morning): Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for early morning, but today at 07:50 it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1. The "nightstand_b1 pre-09:00" heuristic is unreliable; glasses are often at bathroom_shelf_ba1 before work. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 for glasses before 09:00.

General Pattern: The "desk_o1 as central hub" heuristic is actually reliable for Dana’s drinkware during work hours (09:00-17:00). Location is highly time-dependent: pre-09:00 check bathroom_shelf_ba1 (glasses) and cupboard_k1 (mugs); 09:00-17:00 check desk_o1 for both glasses and water bottles; post-18:00 check kitchen_table_k1 for water bottles and counter_k1 for glasses. Do not default to kitchen spots during work hours.
